chunks: Aḥmad ibn Mihrān, may Allah have mercy on him, from ʿAbd al-ʿAẓīm al-Ḥasanī, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from ʿAlī ibn ʿUqbah, from al-Ḥakam ibn Ayman, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the word of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
“Those who listen to the word, then follow the best of it.”

Up to the end of the verse. He said: “They are those who submit to the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, those who, when they hear the hadith, neither add to it nor diminish from it; they bring it just as they heard it.”

key_terms.أَحْسَنَهُ: the best and most proper of it
key_terms.الْقَوْلَ: the speech or word being heard
key_terms.فَيَتَّبِعُونَ: then they follow in practice and commitment
key_terms.لِآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: to the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: Who are “those who listen to the word and follow the best of it” according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام explains the verse as referring to those who submit to Āl Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and faithfully preserve hadith as they received it. Its significance lies in linking true receptivity to divine speech with loyalty to the Ahl al-Bayt and precision in transmitting religious knowledge.
